title: LLUMI: Improving LLM Writing Assistance for Mental Health Support with Online Community Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2605.30273v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in generating supportive responses for mental health queries, but improving their usefulness, empathy, and safety often requires substantial compute, expert input, and labeled data. At the same time, deploying proprietary, cloud-based models for mental health-related interactions raises important privacy and data-governance concerns, given the sensitivities. To address this challenge, we introduce LLUMI setup that can be hosted in-house within protected environments. LLUMI consists of two complementary components: a generation model (GM), which drafts supportive responses to mental health queries, and an improvement model (IM), which revises an initial human-crafted response. We leverage feedback signals from Reddit mental health communities, using community endorsement patterns such as upvotes and downvotes to construct chosen--rejected response pairs for Supervised Fine Tuning (SFT) a

translated_title: LLUMI：利用在线社区反馈改进用于心理健康支持的LLM写作辅助
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在为心理健康咨询生成支持性回复方面展现出巨大潜力，但提升其有用性、共情能力和安全性通常需要大量的计算资源、专家投入和标注数据。同时，鉴于心理健康相关信息的敏感性，部署基于云端的专有模型会引发重要的隐私和数据治理问题。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了LLUMI，这是一个可以在受保护环境中内部部署的系统。LLUMI由两个互补的组件构成：生成模型（GM），用于起草针对心理健康咨询的支持性回复；以及改进模型（IM），用于修订初始的人工撰写回复。我们利用来自Reddit心理健康社区的反馈信号，通过点赞和点踩等社区认可模式构建“优选—拒绝”回复对，用于监督微调（SFT）。
tldr: LLUMI是一个可内部部署的双模型系统（生成模型和改进模型），通过利用Reddit心理健康社区的点赞反馈信号进行监督微调，在不依赖大量计算资源、专家输入和云端专有模型的情况下，改进了LLM在心理健康写作辅助中的有用性、共情能力和安全性。
en_tdlr: LLUMI is an in-house deployable dual-model system (a generation model and an improvement model) that leverages upvote feedback signals from Reddit mental health communities for supervised fine-tuning, improving the helpfulness, empathy, and safety of LLM writing assistance for mental health support without requiring substantial compute, expert input, or cloud-based proprietary models.
